description: This Java class 'BreadcrumbsUtils' provides utility methods for building breadcrumb navigation structures for categories and products in an e-commerce web application. It constructs breadcrumb objects based on category lineage and product references, integrating with category and store services.

classes.name: BreadcrumbsUtils
classes.description: Utility class for constructing breadcrumb navigation objects for categories and products.

methods.name: buildCategoryBreadcrumb
methods.description: Builds a breadcrumb trail for a clicked category, including parent categories based on lineage.

methods.name: buildProductBreadcrumb
methods.description: Builds a breadcrumb trail for a clicked product, including its category path.

methods.name: parseBreadCrumb
methods.description: Parses breadcrumb reference content string into a list of category IDs.

methods.name: parseCategoryLineage
methods.description: Parses category lineage string into a list of category IDs.

methods.name: buildBreadCrumb
methods.description: Constructs a breadcrumb string from a list of category IDs.
